newsitem.title: CHINA: Dow Corning opens first China manufacturing plant.
newsitem.headline: Dow Corning opens first China manufacturing plant.

text.p: U.S. company Dow Corning Corp has opened its first China manufacturing facility in Shanghai to produce silicon-based products, it said in a statement on Friday.
The plant, located in Shanghai's Songjiang industrial zone, will produce silicon emulsion and sealant, the statement said. It did not give an exact figure for investment in the facility.
The plant's products will be sold to customers in the textile and construction industries, as well as rubber and plastic processing, the statement said.
Dow Corning, a joint venture between Dow Chemical and Corning Inc, plans to expand the plant to manufacture more upstream, silicon-based products as demand develops, it said.
Company chairman and chief executive officer Richard Hazleton was quoted as saying that Dow Corning's sales in China are expected to grow by 25 percent annually for the next several years.
Dow Corning applied for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in May 1995 because of a crush of litigation in the United States over silicone breast implants.
